regional_summary_6h.headline: Iranian retaliation threats after US wedding strike dominate; Georgian CBRN drills signal heightened border security
bullets: Iran threatens a tougher strategy after US strikes killed four at a wedding in southern Iran, labeling the strike a war crime.
Iranian forces struck a Saudi tanker, killing two Filipino sailors, a direct retaliatory signal.
Georgian and US agencies conducted chemical-biological threat response drills in Batumi, reinforcing border security along the Black Sea.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Russia's conditional closure of Gyumri base could reshape Russian military posture in Armenia, affecting regional deterrence.
